units.N-negative-random: Random DNA of 31-200 bp on /pattern: exact 0, complete.
units.N-negative-shuffled: A shuffled record window: 0 paths on /pattern and no k-mer in the graph on /resolve.
units.N-negative-discover: Random DNA under discovery: nothing to discover.
units.N-negative-seed: A random seed on /traverse: the seed's 400, never a walk.
units.N-negative-peptide: A random peptide of 10-30 low-degeneracy residues: exact 0.
units.N-nearmiss-pairs: More substitutions than max_mismatches put the source out of reach; the pair with m substitutions brings it back at level m.
units.N-nearmiss-peptide: A decapeptide with 2-4 substituted residues at max_mismatches 1: out of reach.
units.N-nearmiss-mutated: A substitution every 15 bases leaves no k-mer of the record; one substitution breaks the runs there with both sides supported; a mutated seed is refused by /traverse.
units.N-hard-lowcomplex: Low-complexity patterns: exact counts within the stated bound, the note stated or absent as documented; with paths, stated stops or a cut.
units.N-hard-repeat: A 31-mer of a multi-copy repeat is counted and resolved with every k-mer carried; a telomeric seed re-enters itself at 0 bp (rejoined_seed).
units.N-realrep: Real tandem repeats of the records: the pattern's contexts (note as documented), the resolve fully supported, the traverse following the record to its re-entry.
units.N-usecase-primers: A universal 16S primer (IUPAC) on both strands is counted, at least E. coli K-12's sites.
units.N-usecase-strand: A forward-only search of a reverse primer or of a reverse complement counts what the record holds on +.
units.N-usecase-floor: Too short or too degenerate patterns are below the floor; a 26-bit degenerate one is admitted and costly.
units.N-usecase-identify: Identify a read: discovery names its taxid; its first 31 bp are placed in its record.
units.N-usecase-defect: The 2026-10-09 defect: a 31-mer of NC_000932.1 is in the graph but its header carries none of it.
units.N-nearmiss2: A 25-mer with 3 spread substitutions and a reverse-complement 31-mer with 4 are out of reach; the pair with 1 substitution is back at level 1.
units.N-zero: exact 0 on /pattern iff a k-mer is absent on /resolve (relation zero_equals_absent).
